title: NASA’s Webb reveals the wild weather of a mysterious world 20 light-years away
caption:
Astronomers analyzing a brown dwarf 20 light-years away discovered that its stormy skies actually follow an orderly rhythm. By measuring subtle brightness shifts with NASA's Webb telescope, researchers uncovered three repeating weather systems driven by heat and cloud height.

Source: Sciencedaily - NASA’s Webb reveals the wild weather of a mysterious world 20 light-years away
